line: # The hydraulic circuit (design.md). The contract is toolkit/hyd.py and the checks toolkit/v_hyd.py (HYD-001..008
to: core watch 2026-11-10); they read an assembly's hyd.csv and hyd-circuit.csv
fluid: so this file stays the design until the press has its assembly.py. Fluid: ISO VG 46 mineral oil
p_bar: ISO 11158 category HM (HLP 46 is DIN 51524-2's name for it; pneu-8 H7).

size: hose-hyd 1/2 in (Assumption: 22 l/min at under 6 m/s: ISO 4413 recommends; bore 10.7 mm gives 4.1 m/s)
note: pump to valve; the gauge, pressure switch and pt tee off this line at the HPU's gauge port

cap end: ram down; a counterbalance valve (valve-counterbalance, EM 2026-11-09: decided; p_set = k × W / A_cap from the ram's mass): a pneu lane element; which line it belongs in is EM's question, needs-em 2026-11-10: the ram's weight pressurises the rod end, B)

rod end: ram up; the meter-out flow control in this line (hyd-flow-control: cyl.B to its port-1, port-2 to v1.B; the ram's weight pressurises the rod end on the down stroke, so the throttle here holds it back, and in A it would meter in and let the ram run ahead of the oil: request pneu-8 H10)
the HPU's own relief at 160 bar protects every element: hyd-cylinder-da-40 p_max 160 (HYD-003, request pneu-8)
